gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Paprika scatters its letters wide, with lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Noto Sans Tai Viet follows with a tall x-height and pulled-back terminals, so the pair feels both loud and friendly.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Paprika spreads out with big, expressive lowercase that fills the line like capitals, hollow and loose inside its counters. Noto Sans Tamil stays modern beside it.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supple: Paprika's counters breathe open like a cut reed, and its lowercase crowds the line like capitals. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement has round forms like open parentheses and such a tall middle band that, if the heading shrinks, the body can look the stronger of the two.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Commanding up top, Paprika stretches its lowercase until it fills the line like capitals, with scattered letters and hollow counters. Noto Sans Tangsa sits beside it, welcoming and round.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC reads openly, with large counters in a, e and s and curves that flare outward. Paprika brings the loud, scattered display voice above it, while the plain sans keeps the text approachable.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu reads in a steady, businesslike way, with a high-set midline and counters that stay open to the outside. Paprika does the shouting, with lowercase that fills the line like capitals, and the sans handles the quiet running text.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-thai: Puffed up and friendly, Noto Sans Thai has a lowercase like inflated glass beads and rounded letters left open. Paprika's wide-scattered display letters sit above it, and the plain sans cools them down.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Tall, heavy-looking lowercase gives Noto Sans Thai Looped real presence, with spacious gaps where its curves end. Paprika, expressive and commanding, lets the sans carry the quieter work.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Clean as a mood, Paprika is the loud one, spreading lowercase that fills the line like capitals across the display. Noto Sans Tifinagh does the opposite job, offering rounded, open bowls that feel inviting up close.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Contemporary and spare, Paprika scatters its letters wide and fills lines with capital-sized lowercase. Noto Sans Tirhuta, with its dominant x-height and cut-back terminals, keeps long reading open and easy to take in.
